messages:
maria: seeing a spike of s3 PutObject ops from analytics-sa to sensitive-bucket at ~08:12 UTC. Not expected after last week's hardening. anyone aware of RBAC changes?
kevin: i merged infra PR #421 at 08:05 to consolidate analytics roles, might be related. quick look now.
jaz: oncall: KMS decrypt logs show analytics-sa calling key alias/rdw-sensitive at 08:11-08:18 repeatedly. some succeeded before 08:20.
ops-bot: Deploy 421 merged by kevin at 2026-03-15T08:05:12Z (sha 8f3b2a).
maria: can we stop writes to that bucket until we triage? temp deny would be safest.
kevin: easy to patch but wary of breaking pods. thinking `kubectl patch sa analytics-sa -n analytics -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"rbac-revoked":"true"}}}'` to force new tokens.
priya: do not patch SA annotation as a way to revoke. that can cause pods to crash unexpectedly. better: rotate the vault token for analytics SA and apply a deny policy at S3/KMS layer.
maria: good call. jaz can you add KMS deny to block decrypt for analytics principal while we confirm scope?
jaz: preparing a deny policy snippet. posting: 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "DenyAnalyticsKmsDecrypt",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/analytics-sa"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01",
      "Condition": {}
    }
  ]
}
```
maria: netsec @netsec please weigh in on retaining read but denying write/decrypt. we must avoid breaking live read-only analytics dashboards.
netsec: acceptable to deny PutObject and KMS decrypt for that principal until we revert the role change. we should prefer org-level deny so it applies instantly.
kevin: applied org deny for s3:PutObject on sensitive-bucket for analytics-sa principal at 2026-03-15T08:20:09Z.
ops-bot: Org policy change applied by kevin at 2026-03-15T08:20:09Z.
jaz: after deny applied, PutObject attempts dropped to 0. KMS decrypt attempts still present but now failing with 403.
maria: good containment. any signs of data exfil?
jaz: no outgoing endpoints seen. writes were attempted to the bucket only. audit shows no GetObject anomalies.
kevin: i'm rolling back PR #421 (reverting commit 8f3b2a) to restore pre-change permissions while we design narrower role. will deploy shortly.
ops-bot: Rollback (revert 8f3b2a) started by kevin at 2026-03-15T08:31:22Z.
ops-bot: Rollback completed at 2026-03-15T08:35:41Z.
maria: confirm S3 and KMS permissions are back to baseline for other services.
priya: validated: reads still work, writes blocked for analytics-sa (as intended). rotating service account tokens and scheduling KMS key access review for tomorrow. filing change request.
netsec: please create an incident ticket and postmortem. include which CI check allowed the role grant without human review. also add a temporary gating rule to block role grants with s3:PutObject unless approved.
maria: opened INC-4521 and added initial timeline. assigning follow-ups: kevin -> infra guardrails, jaz -> audit log export & retention extension, priya -> token rotation, netsec -> policy checklist for compliance.
kevin: i'll add a pre-merge CI job to scan for broad permissions and ban direct s3:PutObject grants in analytics roles unless flagged with '/security-approve'.
maria: thanks. let's keep monitoring for 24h and keep this high until postmortem complete. no evidence of data exfil so far :eyes: :white_check_mark:
netsec: will invite legal only if we see cross-account copies or unusual external PUTs. for now preserve all logs and snapshots for 90 days per compliance.
maria: summary of immediate actions: 1) applied org-level deny (done), 2) rolled back PR (done), 3) rotate tokens & review KMS access (in progress), 4) CI guardrails and policy checks (in progress), 5) postmortem + audit export (open).
kevin: thanks everyone. follow-up PRs incoming, will request security review before merge.
priya: i'll coordinate token rotation window and update runbook for safe SA revocation.
maria: closing the active paging loop, keeping thread open for follow-ups.
